invariants: Provider owns a HouseFactory in a private field; the client never names the factory type.
get_dog() delegates to the factory's dog(); get_cat() delegates to the factory's new_cat().
responsibilities: give the client the house dog (get_dog)
give the client a new cat (get_cat)
keep the factory and all sharing rules invisible to the client
summary: The client's only door to animals. Owns the factory and hides it completely.
